data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Switching 10 to 18 adds $8,000 now if filled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; each switch cuts the low outcome by16. These assume stated catches; intentions aren't binding, and long-run gains aren't assured.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisherman this month: 25 × 10 = 250 tons caught, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That earns each of us $10,000 monthly while preserving future income. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to state whether they support this cap. Let's review revealed catches afterward and coordinate again.

I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to do the same; catches afterward let us assess compliance.
